title: Fun Segway tour of Barcelona!!
text: Ronni was an excellent guide and showed us the known and less known parts of Barcelona including Gaudi buildings.  We had also had great fun on the segways!
author: Timothy_D

title: Segway tour in Barcelona
text: So fun w Anton!! we were able to learn how to do a Segway for the first time with his skillful quick and mindful teaching, went all over the beach areas, in town and through parks! Even got to paint a bit and feed parrots!!
author: Diann_V

title: Anton was great!
text: Anton was a great guide, host, teacher. Frankly, the E bikes looked like they had seen better days and we converted to Segway. We own an E bike so we know how to assess the quality and maintenance. We saw much more of the city, and Anton made the pivot so enticing and it was the best thing EVER! LOVED IT!
author: Harold_G

title: Wonderful overview of history of Barcelona!
text: Nuno was the most wonderful guide!  He shared the history of Barcelona in great detail with wit and charm.  His engaging personality made the experience come alive and we could not have asked for better!   Thank you, Nuno!
author: Elizabeth_W
